Module 03 · Amplified work

Accessible guide: amplified work

Align owners, controls, and AI use so the team can deliver repeatably without weakening professional judgment.

PDF
12 · Moments
SHA-256

Official masterclass PDF

The official PDF is untagged and contains text embedded in images. Use this accessible HTML guide to follow its 12 moments.
Open PDF Download PDF
MasterclassWorkbookPlaybookPromptsAll resources
For teams

Turn expert practice into a shared way of working.

When the method lives with one person, handoffs vary, review arrives late, and AI amplifies inconsistency.

What you will gain

The team will leave with a common Mini-SOP, review points, accountable owners, and evidence from a bounded pilot.

How to proceed

Select a workflow, observe variants, agree on the standard, co-design the Mini-SOP, and run a pilot with a human owner.

What to verify

A Mini-SOP with roles, inputs, steps, criteria, approvals, exceptions, and a team-pilot record.

Design the team workflow

Test the workflow with a second team member and adjust only from pilot evidence.
